body.name: Noncommuting quadratic Brenier pair
body.construction: On \(\Omega_{\square}\) with \(U\sim\mu_{\square}\), set \(F_0(u)=A_0u\) and \(F_1(u)=A_1u\). Their potentials are \(u\mapsto u^{\mathsf T}A_0u/2\) and \(u\mapsto u^{\mathsf T}A_1u/2\). For \(j_{\mathrm{dyn}}\in\{0,1\}\), \(u\mapsto[(1-\lambda)I_2+\lambda A_{j_{\mathrm{dyn}}}]u\) is a Lipschitz dynamic optimal-transport interpolation with time-one map \(F_j\).
